newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat orders eight security officers dismissed.
newsitem.headline: Arafat orders eight security officers dismissed.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat has ordered the dismissal of eight senior security officers in the West Bank for corruption, a senior PLO official said on Saturday.
"There were orders to fire five police colonels and three military intelligence colonels for reasons of corruption," the official said without elaborating.
The official, who asked not to be identified, told Reuters that Arafat issued the dismissal orders last week during a visit to the self-ruled town of Ramallah.

He said there were also orders to fire six other officers in Ramallah after rivalries between members of two security agencies, the Palestinian National Forces and the police, erupted into a gunbattle last week. Four policemen were wounded.
PLO officials said the dismissals were the first ordered by Arafat against security officials since he returned to self-rule areas from exile in 1994.

Last year Arafat demoted several senior security officials for ordering their forces to storm al-Najah University in the West Bank city of Nablus in a raid against student supporters of the militant Hamas group.
Some officers were also jailed and interrogated in the Gaza Strip for alleged military misconduct.
